description: This file defines the EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao class, which provides data access methods for retrieving attendance records in an HR management system. It contains methods to fetch the latest attendance record, attendance records within a date range, and open attendance records for a specific employee.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for employee time records at work, extending the base DAO class to provide specific queries related to attendance.

methods.name: getLatestAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent attendance record for a given employee by their employee number.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmployeeAndDate
methods.description: Fetches all attendance records for a specified employee within a given UTC date range.

methods.name: getOpenAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an open attendance record for an employee, i.e., currently punched in.
